name: Dynamic OTP
description: A dynamic OTP input that transitions directly into a loading spinner.
longDescription: An experimental OTP input built with react-native-reanimated. Instead of navigating to a separate screen or showing a standard loader, the input boxes themselves rearrange into a spinning loader when the code is submitted. It includes spring-based animations for both error and success states.
author: tripookie
features: Radial arm physics engine for perfect morphing

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Callback triggered when all 4 digits are entered

props.name: status
props.description: Controls the current animated state of the component
